assets.name: chair_oak
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent furniture thumbnail PNG for a Godot fantasy shop decoration inventory UI.
The supplied image is a STYLE reference only. Generate just ONE isolated furniture asset, not the UI or scene.
Style: premium warm stylized realistic 3D game item illustration, softly hand-painted material finish with convincing fine wood and brass texture, matching the reference's furniture icons. Restrained details readable at 160px. Camera: fixed high three-quarter view approximately 30 degrees downward, see front and right side, minimal perspective distortion. Warm soft key light from upper left, soft neutral fill. Center the complete object inside a square 1024x1024 canvas with at least 10 percent empty margin; no cropping.
Background MUST be genuinely transparent RGBA alpha, not white, not black, not a drawn checkerboard. The empty region, and all holes between legs or components, must be transparent. No floor, no backdrop, no card, no frame, no scene, no ground shadow, no text, no numbers, no symbols, no watermark. Preserve only the object's natural internal contact shading.
Subject: one sturdy tavern armchair in rich warm dark walnut-toned oak, tall straight slatted wooden back with five vertical slats, four squared tapered legs, two simple wooden armrests, a worn warm beige woven seat cushion. Elegant practical cozy fantasy merchant furniture. Fine bevels catch gold warm light. No other object.
assets.framing_adjustment_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / transparent game UI asset padding. Edit only the framing of this existing isolated chair_oak image. Preserve the exact furniture design, materials, colors, perspective, details, and warm lighting. Reduce the COMPLETE object's apparent size so its maximum visible dimension occupies only 70% of the square canvas, centered horizontally and vertically, leaving approximately 15% entirely transparent margin on ALL four sides. This is a UI thumbnail with essential safety padding. Keep all furniture complete. Keep the background genuinely transparent RGBA alpha, including holes. No floor, shadow, white, checkerboard, frame, labels, text, or added objects. Prefer 1024x1024 square. Change framing ONLY; do not redesign or simplify the object.
